record.one_liner: Graph database platform queried with Cypher, offered self-managed and as the AuraDB cloud service, with HTTP Query and Aura management APIs.
record.auth_notes: critic: removed api_key and other, added oauth2. Aura API docs state it uses OAuth 2.0 (client_credentials grant; Client ID/Secret exchanged at /oauth/token via HTTP Basic for a Bearer token). Query API accepts HTTP Basic or Bearer tokens.
record.access_notes: critic: confirmed. Aura API credentials can be created on every tier including Free. Aura Free and trial accounts without billing are limited to 25 requests per minute. Self-managed Community Edition is also free.
record.api_notes: Hinted neo4j.com/docs/api returned 404, so Query API and Aura API docs were used. Primary data access is Bolt drivers. HTTP Query API runs Cypher; Aura API covers instance management.

evidence.quote: Both basic and bearer authentication are supported.
The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
A complete list of the available endpoints can be seen and tested in the API Specification.
Documentation: The official Neo4j MCP documentation.
